about: Every step a pipeline can name (docs/PIPELINES.md §3). check: local = pipeline.py checks it itself; run = a command that must exit 0; mcp = a connector call the run records with pipeline.py done; manual = a judgement the run records with pipeline.py done --note. gate: strict (must pass), review (record it), planned (shown, not yet enforced). per: chapter = once per chapter.

classify.title: Which flow is this?
classify.what: Run pipeline.py detect with what the learner gave and asked, then pipeline.py start <flow>. Every later step follows the flow's list; never skip a strict step.

shape.title: Shape of the Roadmap
shape.what: Decide focus, the size of the core (maxCore) and the perspectives, and ask the learner only what is essential.

dag.title: The map (DAG)
dag.what: The steps and their prerequisites: noema_create_roadmap, then the "dag" agent task of noema_curriculum_task.

audit.title: Audit the map
audit.what: The "audit" agent task: missing prerequisites, cycles, steps too big.

expand.title: Expand the map
expand.what: The "expand" agent task: split steps that are too big (a step whose core set would pass ~180 exercises is a candidate — a mild suggestion, never a cut of knowledge points).

plan.title: Chapter plan
plan.what: The plan of each step's chapters with its requiredCoverage (noema_curriculum_task "plan").

start_subject.title: Start the subject folder
start_subject.what: python3 scripts/start_subject.py work <id> "Title" --lang <code> [--code] [--math]: writes authoring.rules 2 (the quality rules) and the map/ and review/ folders.

map.title: Knowledge map (before any exercise)
map.what: For every chapter map/chNN.json: EVERY knowledge point of the material (exhaustive; points an earlier DAG node taught get taughtIn), its level and categories (13 hunts), confusable pairs (with), the learnables, fits/unfit (every type, focus tag and paradigm that fits, a reason for each that does not) and every question of the sources.

pictures.title: Pictures that teach
pictures.what: Only pictures with high teaching value: from the sources (never all of them), the web or drawn diagrams. A chapter may have none. Each picture gets >= 3 picture exercises.

check.manual: every picture kept teaches something the text alone cannot show

write.title: Theory and exercises
write.what: chapters/chNN.json from the map: self-contained theory and exercises (no pointers to the source structure), several versions (facades) of each learnable in different types, every exercise with lr, think, cite (and mode where it uses a paradigm).

blind_solve.title: Blind re-solve
blind_solve.what: Solve every exercise without looking at the key; record solved and every mismatch in review/chNN.json "blind", fix each one (fixed: true). (The review step hashes review/chNN.json for both.)

review.title: Second-pass review
review.what: The rubric on >= 15 learnables (or all) in review/chNN.json "rubric"; fix what fails.

checks.title: Every check (make_pack.py)
checks.what: python3 scripts/make_pack.py work/<id>: the quality rules of tools/pack_rules.json on every chapter, every translation against its chapter. Never deliver a pack that fails.

upload.title: Save to the learner's account
upload.what: noema_start_upload → curl → noema_finish_upload (it checks the pack again, then asks for the source files and the translations), then noema_save_bridge for each bridge.

translate.title: Translations (en, el, ru)
translate.what: A full translation of every chapter into each of English, Greek and Russian other than the pack's language (translations/<locale>/chNN.json: same ids, sections, answers and code; only the words change). make_pack.py writes each as its own file (build/<id>.tr.<locale>.json) and noema_finish_upload asks for them.

bridges.title: Language help 文A (en, el, ru, ar)
bridges.what: A 文A bridge into each of en, el, ru, ar other than the pack's language, everyday words included (learners may be A2/B1): bridge.py todo / build / check — it covers >= 90 % of the content words and >= 80 % of the everyday ones. Save each with noema_save_bridge after the upload.

next.title: The next step
next.what: noema_curriculum_task again: the next queued step, or tell the learner what is ready.

import.title: Import a map or a subject
import.what: Check the file (validate.py / checkPack) and import it: a pack the learner made is held to the rules as warnings only.

L.brief.title: Brief and contract first
L.brief.what: Start from tools/lang_sources/AGENT_BRIEF.md and the checklist §C of docs/LANGUAGE_RULES.md (A1: contract first; a plan change goes into docs/LANGUAGES.md and LANGUAGE_RULES.md first).

check.manual: the brief names D13, D14/D15, D19, R2, R3, D20, D22–D24, D25

L.phenomena.title: Phenomena catalogue (D14, D16)
L.phenomena.what: library/languages/_phenomena/<code>.json: what the language has and has not, in the shared typology.

L.params.title: Word parameters (R3, D28)
L.params.what: WORD_PARAMETERS.md and wordFeatures BEFORE any word.

L.order.title: The common order (D13, D10)
L.order.what: Every topic at its place in the common order of all language paths.

L.words.title: Words with their whole facade (D14, D15, D5, D6, D24)
L.words.what: Every meaning a concept, inflection tables, transliteration.

L.grounding.title: Grounding (refcheck)
L.grounding.what: Every word and form checked against the references.

L.grammar.title: Grammar points (D9, D12, D22, D26)
L.grammar.what: Grammar apart from the words, with its category.

L.notes.title: Notes for every native (D19, R1, R2)
L.notes.what: Structured contrast notes for every supported native language and for the types (branch:…).

L.sentences.title: Sentences from taught words only (D20, D23)
L.sentences.what: In S00–S18 only words already taught; new words marked.

L.exercises.title: Exercises from stored data (D3, D27)
L.exercises.what: Exercises only from stored, checked data; every card item is practised.

L.package.title: The language package (§10.2)
L.package.what: python3 tools/lang_course.py package <course> <code>, then noema_lang_package_start → curl → noema_lang_package_finish.

L.facades.title: Explanations in every UI language (D1, D19)
L.facades.what: facades/<locale>/: the translated explanations, a separate task.

L.task.title: A task of an existing course
L.task.what: noema_lang_task → answer → check every answer with the toolkit → noema_lang_submit.

L.green.title: Green before commit (A2)
L.green.what: tools/build.py and tests/run_e2e.sh (tests/lang_frame.js skipped while in development), tests/lang_rules.py.
